lines.en: Soft feet along the dune.
Small body, quick steps.
Claws sink into the dry riverbed.
I work the alluvial flats.
Nose to the ground, sniffing.
Eyes up, then down again.
A burrow. Noted.
The Cretaceous wind is dry.

lines.zh: 我一步三停，怕有更大的。
lines.en: Three stops a step, wary of bigger things.

lines.zh: 细长的尾巴在我身后摆。
lines.en: My slim tail swings behind.
Feathers lie flat and neat.
I skirt the loose stones.
Low and quick through the dry grass.
My prints are shallow; wind erases them.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边听地下的声。
lines.en: Walking while listening underground.
Standing, my head keeps turning.
No danger far off. For now.
The wind lifts my feathers.
Counting the burrow mouths.

lines.zh: 我这样的小东西活得谨慎。
lines.en: A creature my size lives carefully.
Something big called. I stay still.
My claws scratch at the sand.
Daylight doesn't suit me.
Waiting for it to darken.
I press myself to the ground.
Two small teeth show.
The wind carries too many smells.
I tilt my head and glance.
Is something moving in the nest?
I guard this patch. Keep off.
I listen a while longer.
You're taller than these trees.
I don't plan to come near you.
Standing there makes me nervous.
You just stepped on my ground.
Short legs, but I run fast.
Your smell is far too new.
I've young ones to watch.
Going to grab me? Consider this a warning.
Don't reach your hand down this way.

lines.zh: 躲进洞的猎物，我也拖得出来.
lines.en: I can drag prey out of its burrow.

lines.zh: 这一撞把我掀进干河床的沙里。
lines.en: The blow flips me into the dry riverbed sand.
Backing behind the sand heap.
Blood drips into the sand.
My wing-like arms shield me.
I shrink back into the burrow.
Careful! You'll rattle me apart.

lines.zh: 我只是只小恐龙，别打我！
lines.en: I'm just a little dinosaur. Don't hit me!

lines.zh: 疼得我羽毛都竖起来了。
lines.en: That hurts so much my feathers are standing up.
Is that thing meat?
I don't eat plant matter.
That's not enough for me.
I know the smell of blood.
I want it alive and moving.
That meat's still warm.
Too close. I won't come.
Throw a piece further off first.
I'll snatch the meat and run.
You knocked into the sand heap.
I backed off very fast.
You're blocking the burrow.
I darted out from your feet.
I'm small. I can squeeze through.
Dust puffed up from the sand.

lines.zh: 我把洞里的东西拖出来。
lines.en: I drag what is in the burrow out.

lines.zh: 贴地跑，才不容易被抓住。
lines.en: Running low keeps me from being caught.
I only pair in season.
I guard the young, not a mate.
That's not your concern.
I'm too small for such talk.
After the young are grown.
I'll call. Not to you.
That isn't your question to ask.
I turn and duck into the burrow.
I won't answer that question.
There are others in this land.
This bone will wear my teeth down.
This meat is mine.
Doesn't smell edible.
Too heavy. I can't drag it.
This could line the nest.
There's a small bug inside.
I carry it back to the burrow.

lines.zh: 一根羽毛，我叼起来又放下。
lines.en: A feather; I pick it up and set it down.
Something's moving past the dune.

lines.zh: 我看见洞口有一道影子。
lines.en: A shadow at the burrow mouth.
I've marked it already.
Smaller than me. Perfect.
Don't move. Let me see first.
It's heading for that burrow.
I can pounce from here.
I drop low against the sand.
My tail is straight behind me.
It still hasn't noticed me.
I'll let it come a bit closer.
My legs are already loaded.
It's poking its head out.
I wait for it to come all the way out.
Soft sand will sink my dash.
Just half a step closer.
It stopped to sniff.
My claws are set to dig in.
It looks about to bolt.
I've shifted upwind.
My shadow overlaps it.
I hold my breath and stay still.

lines.zh: 你侧过身，正好露出脖子。
lines.en: You turn, and your neck is exposed just right.
It's backed into the burrow.
I can drag it back out.
That pounce went wide.
I kick off with my hind claws.
Small teeth, but fast.
It went over and I pinned it.
I raked it once.
My tail helps me turn.

lines.zh: 这一下带着羽毛的味道。
lines.en: This one smells of feathers.
I break off and stop chasing.
My teeth hit bone.
It leapt clear and I lost balance.
The Cretaceous riverbed is bright.
I shake the sand off my feathers.

lines.zh: 这里的气味和巢不一样。
lines.en: This doesn't smell like the nest.
Small as I am, no one notices.
I stand on the dune slope.
Wind pushes the sand along.
First I find a burrow to hide in.
I hear something bellowing.
My feet sink a little.
The light's just right, not harsh.
Low body, observation first.
There are others of my kind nearby.
My prints mark the dune.
Hot sand and flame make me hop.

lines.zh: 从沙丘上滚下去，摔晕了。
lines.en: Rolled down the dune and dazed myself.

lines.zh: 干河床突然有水，我呛住了。
lines.en: Water in a dry riverbed? I choked.
The blast threw all the sand up.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉穿了我的尾巴。
lines.en: An arrow pinned my tail.
That light made my feathers stand up.
Hunger's made my legs soft.

lines.zh: 雷劈在沙丘上，我耳里嗡嗡。
lines.en: Lightning hit the dune. My ears ring.
The sand's gone and I keep falling.
